The vendor directly providing **MythBlender** at **mythblender.com** is **MythBlender Group** (also operating as **MythBlender**).

### Evidence
* **Terms of Use (`mythblender.com`):** *"These MythBlender Terms of Use explain the relationship between MythBlender Group (\"MythBlender\") and you when you access and use mythblender.com and its related domains and browser extensions."*
* **Privacy Policy (`mythblender.com`):** *"MythBlender Group (\"MythBlender\") operates the mythblender.com website (“Site”). This privacy policy sets out how MythBlender Group. uses and protects any information that you give us when you use this Service."*
